description:
The exchanges that list one specific token, with per-venue metadata. Use it when the user asks where a token trades or which venues carry it, rather than for a price on any one of them.

[Access: pay 0.001 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

symbol.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC or ETH.
